_comment: Biome table for procedural terrain. Each column samples temperature + moisture + continentalness (all 0..1, low-frequency noise). The biome whose climate-cell CENTRE (mid of its temp/moisture ranges) is nearest the column's (temperature, moisture) supplies the surface/subsurface/deep materials. heightScale/heightOffset shape the terrain elevation and are BLENDED smoothly across nearby biomes (Gaussian by climate distance) so borders don't cliff. Continentalness adds a large-scale base elevation on top. Materials are names from materials.json.
